newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed restarts Fermi nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed restarts Fermi nuclear unit.

text.p: Detroit Edison Co is in the process of restarting its 1,116 megawatt (MW) Fermi 2 nuclear power plant, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.

The NRC, in its daily plant status report, said Fermi was in "condition 2 startup" and currently producing at five percent of its rated output. It did not indicate when the unit would likely synchronize to the grid.
The company said earlier this week the outage, begun December 28, was due to problems with instrumentation on the plant's backfill system.
The company said Monday that it expected the unit to restart within the next couple of days.
The Fermi unit is in Newport, Mich.
